text: `configurations` and `estate` are a versioned export: nix#exports.version (1), checked by a test
why: Tend and vg-paradigms' layers above read them (vg-paradigms' repo model, rule 4: consumers read strictly, producers change through a check). The version sits in its own output, not inside the two, because both are keyed by host name and a `version` key would read as a machine. Renaming or removing a field, or changing its meaning, bumps it; adding one doesn't. exports.test.sh (CI) checks the v1 shape; controls that rename a configurations field or add an estate service field fail it (checked).

title: No KVM in vgwsl2 until Microsoft fixes nested virtualization on AMD (KB5127648)
body: vg-dotfiles-windows answered graft 01a165ae (planned): .wslconfig is right and now declared there; the cause is the October rollup KB5127648, whose AMD hypervisor (hvax64.exe 10.0.26100.9711) regressed nested virtualization (microsoft/WSL#41917, acknowledged 2026-10-19, fix pending, no date). The only workaround, removing the rollup, drops its security fixes: the user's call. Until then NixOS VM tests run on GitHub's runners; the todo here still waits on that graft, which vg-dotfiles-windows re-checks once the fix is installed.

title: The checkout moved to C:\vg-dotfiles; vgwsl2's ~/vg-dotfiles link re-pointed
body: With the Windows repos at the top of C:\ (vg-dotfiles-windows 251054d), this repo moved from C:\vg-workspace\vg-dotfiles to C:\vg-dotfiles. vgwsl2's ~/vg-dotfiles is a hand-made link (not in the config), so it was re-pointed: ln -sfn /mnt/c/vg-dotfiles ~/vg-dotfiles. Nothing in the repo named the old path.
